'''Gallion''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]. Gallion was one of the largest rocky planets in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] and had low [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]], allowing lifeforms on the world to develop to titanic sizes.
